title: Laredo Little Theatre Tickets on Sale for 'A Tuna Christmas'
excerpt: Tickets are on sale for the Laredo Little Theatre's 2026 holiday production of 'A Tuna Christmas,' running Dec. 10-20 at the theatre on Thomas Avenue.
content:
Tickets are on sale for the Laredo Little Theatre's 2026 holiday production of “A Tuna Christmas,” KGNS reported Nov. 25.

The show runs Dec. 10-20, 2026, at the Laredo Little Theatre, 4802 Thomas Ave. It is produced by A.B. Barrera and directed by Victor Serna and Nina Vela-Cuellar.

The comedy is the second play in the Greater Tuna series. It takes audiences to Tuna, Texas, the fictional third-smallest town in Texas, where two local radio personalities report on the town's holiday happenings.

Four adult actors play 22 different characters in the production.

Tickets are available through the theatre. For tickets and table reservations, contact A.B. Barrera at (956) 285-4338 or Laura Quesada at (956) 489-6391, or visit laredolittletheatre.org.

Sources: KGNS — “Laredo Little Theatre tickets on sale for ‘A Tuna Christmas’”, Nov. 25, 2026; Laredo Little Theatre, http://www.laredolittletheatre.org/
